{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/trial.csv'
data = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Drop duplicate patient_id entries, keeping the highest sample_seq
# This ensures each patient appears only once, with their latest test
# Note: sample_seq is 1-indexed, so higher = later
data = data.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify the data has been reduced correctly
print(f"Original rows: {len(data) + 1000} (before deduplication)")
print(f"Deduplicated rows: {len(data)}")

# Check the sites
print("Unique sites:", data['site'].unique())

# Check the response rate by site
response_rate_by_site = data.groupby('site')['responded'].mean()
print("Response rates by site:")
print(response_rate_by_site)

# Confirm the highest response rate
max_site = response_rate_by_site.idxmax()
max_rate = response_rate_by_site.max()

print(f"Site with highest response rate: {max_site} ({max_rate:.3f})")"}
